Trinity Harden is a data maestro!

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
ggplot(mpg, aes(x = displ, y = hwy, color = class)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Bigger Engines, Fewer Highway Miles",
    subtitle = "Engine displacement and highway fuel economy by vehicle class",
    x = "Engine displacement (liters)",
    y = "Highway fuel economy (miles per gallon)",
    color = "Vehicle class",
    caption = "Data: ggplot2::mpg"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
